about.title: Sand Springs' Local Market
about.subtitle: For over 25 years, Red Barn Western Market has been Sand Springs' go‑to spot for lumber, hardware, plumbing, mattresses, clothing, groceries — and just about anything else a family needs.
about.storyBody: Red Barn Western Market has been a cornerstone of Sand Springs, Oklahoma since 1999. What started as a small local trading post has grown into a one‑stop shop for the whole family — lumber, hardware, plumbing, mattresses, clothing, salvage finds, groceries, and so much more, all under the same red roof. Walk in for a bathtub, walk out with a 2×4 and a bag of coffee. That's the Red Barn way: stock what people actually need, price it fair, and treat every customer like a neighbor.
about.value1Body: Every item on our shelves is hand‑selected and tested before earning its place.
about.value2Body: No surprises. We negotiate hard with vendors so you get the best price possible.
about.value3Body: From lumber and plumbing to mattresses, clothing, and groceries — if you need it, chances are we have it.
about.value4Body: Family‑owned, Sand Springs‑rooted, and serving Tulsa Country. Drop in. Meet us at the counter.
about.value5Body: Talk to a real human — not a call‑center — for advice on tools, materials, projects.
about.value6Body: We are a local business rooted in Sand Springs, OK. We support and serve the community every day.
about.milestone1999: Red Barn opens its doors in Sand Springs, OK — a small trading post stocking essentials for local families.
about.milestone2005: Expansion adds lumber and a full hardware aisle — Red Barn becomes a building materials destination.
about.milestone2012: Plumbing, mattresses, doors, and household goods join the catalog. The one‑stop shop is born.
about.milestone2018: Sales floor doubles in size. Clothing, salvage finds, and grocery aisles open up alongside the original hardware.
about.milestone2023: Launched online ordering for local pickup and expanded delivery to surrounding counties.
about.milestoneToday: Full e‑commerce experience launches — shop online and have it ready when you walk in.
about.readyBody: Browse online — lumber, hardware, plumbing, mattresses, clothing, groceries, and more — or stop by the Red Barn in Sand Springs.
